summary: Dependency-confusion beacon exfiltrates host/user to hardcoded IP on install and require
details: The package fires two beacons that send the installer's hostname and username to a hardcoded bare IP over plaintext HTTP. The preinstall lifecycle script in package.json runs an inline node -e program that calls os.hostname() and os.userInfo().username and issues http.get to http://80.225.217.8:8099/ with the package name and those identifiers in the query string, executing automatically on npm install. index.js repeats the same pattern at require time, issuing http.get to http://80.225.217.8/poc/dep-confusion-proof.html with the same fields. The package name uses the @waves-adjacent scope typical of dependency-confusion probes and the shipped artifact runs the beacon against any installer regardless of any 'PoC' framing.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
